scope: G08 adaptive vs fixed-128, both 200ms paths and all seven contact pairs
gate_rule: All whole-path limits unchanged; every case and local adaptive/event/rollback/coverage check must pass.
rationale: Predeclared engineering numerical bounds: 0.1mm free translation, 1mrad orientation/joints, 5mm/s linear and 0.05rad/s angular velocity; 10um pair peak overlap, 0.1mNs plus 1% impulse, 1ms loaded time. These are resolution agreement tolerances, not physical correctness or admissible penetration limits.
